# Sakura Player v1.2.0-beta.4

## 简体中文

本次 Beta 新增歌曲高潮查询与跳转，并包含自 v1.2.0-beta.3 以来的酷狗分页、屏幕常亮和启动修复。

### 新增与改进

- **歌曲高潮**：查询网易云副歌与酷狗高潮标注，复用现有登录会话及酷狗标准版 / 概念版配置；本地、QQ 音乐与流媒体歌曲通过元数据匹配
- **播放体验**：进度条用金色色带显示高潮区间，火焰按钮可一键跳转，支持普通、浮动与全屏布局；暂停时跳转保持暂停，多段标注可依次跳转
- **查询管理**：支持平台回退、有效结果缓存与失败重试，切歌时丢弃过期结果；可在「设置 → 播放设置 → 播放控制 → 获取歌曲高潮」中关闭
- **酷狗修复**：修复歌单、专辑超过 300 首时被截断的问题，完善列表分页与歌曲元数据
- **其他改进**：新增播放页屏幕常亮设置，修复开发环境冷启动及打开设置时触发重载的问题
- **文档**：更新中英文使用指南、README、高潮查询说明与数据处理说明

### 下载与注意事项

- 提供 Windows、macOS、Linux 的 x64 与 ARM64 版本，请选择对应架构和安装形式；本版本属于 Beta 预发行版
- 高潮查询默认开启，需要联网并依赖平台已有标注，不保证每首歌都有结果；不读取或上传音频文件，不进行本地音频分析，插件来源歌曲暂不参与查询
- Windows 安装包未做代码签名，macOS 包未做签名和公证；跨平台 CI 构建不代表已在所有真实设备上完成安装与播放验证
- 使用说明见[歌曲高潮](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/playback.html#歌曲高潮)，完整变更见[版本比较](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/compare/v1.2.0-beta.3...v1.2.0-beta.4)

## English

This Beta adds song highlight lookup and seeking, alongside Kugou pagination, screen-awake, and startup fixes since v1.2.0-beta.3.

### Features and fixes

- **Song highlights:** Query NetEase chorus and Kugou highlight annotations using existing sessions and the selected Kugou standard/concept variant; match local, QQ Music, and streaming tracks by metadata
- **Playback controls:** Gold progress bands show highlight ranges, with a flame button for seeking in regular, floating, and full-screen layouts; seeking preserves pause state and supports multiple annotated ranges
- **Lookup handling:** Cross-platform fallback, caching of valid results, manual retries, and protection against stale results after track changes; disable queries under Settings → Player → Playback control → Find Song Highlights
- **Kugou:** Fix playlists and albums being truncated beyond 300 tracks, and improve pagination and track metadata
- **Other improvements:** Add a screen-awake option for the playback page, and fix development cold starts and reloads when opening Settings
- **Documentation:** Update both language guides, README files, highlight instructions, and data-processing descriptions

### Downloads and limitations

- Windows, macOS, and Linux builds are provided for x64 and ARM64; choose the correct architecture and package type. This is a Beta pre-release
- Highlight lookup is enabled by default and requires network access and existing platform annotations. It does not read or upload audio files or analyze audio locally. Plugin-source tracks do not participate
- Windows packages are unsigned; macOS packages are unsigned and not notarized. CI builds do not replace installation and playback testing on every physical device
- See [Song highlights](https://sakura-player.pyabunny.com/en/playback.html#song-highlights) and the [full comparison](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/compare/v1.2.0-beta.3...v1.2.0-beta.4)
